name: Build A Rocket Boy
short_description: Edinburgh studio founded by Leslie Benzies, longtime lead producer of the Grand Theft Auto series, behind the cinematic action game MindsEye and the creation platform Everywhere.
about:
Build A Rocket Boy was founded in 2018 by Leslie Benzies — the longtime lead producer behind the Grand Theft Auto series at Rockstar North — under the name Royal Circus Games before rebranding. Headquartered in Edinburgh, the studio grew rapidly to several hundred staff across Edinburgh, Budapest and Los Angeles, making it one of the most ambitious new studios in Scotland. Its first major release, MindsEye, is a cinematic action game published by IO Interactive in 2025. Alongside it, the studio has been developing Everywhere, an open-world platform that lets players build, remix and share experiences.

Following a difficult launch for MindsEye, the studio went through significant downsizing and entered administration in September 2026, with the administrators continuing to trade the business.
